reviews.title: Lots of potential - shady purchases
reviews.text:
Good game with tons of bugs. Very high potential to be, in my opinion, a top idle game, but there are way too many games breaking bugs. This, along with the most ads I have ever encountered (before purchasing "ad-free" for $8.99), drop it to 3/5 stars for me. You cannot play the game with the sheer number of ads. 

Now on to the "ad-free" purchase. For the high price of $8.99 you get to play the game normally! You can still watch ads for boosts! Yes, you read that right - you do not get the free ad boosts with the ad-free purchase, you still have to watch the ads. This was not clear on the purchasing. There is also an "ultimate bundle" for $19.99 which also advertises "No Ads". I joined the game discord and received clarification that the "ultimate bundle" ad-free is the same as the $8.99 "ad-free" purchase. The shadiness behind the purchases caused the rating to drop further to 1/5. 

Overall, great ideas, great potential, decent execution, extremely poor (read false advertising) purchase descriptions - 1/5.

reviews.title: Broken Ads Ruin Boosts
reviews.text:
Alright, this game was a nice time killer, but some of its basic functions are hidden behind ad walls such as the pets. Sometimes when I press the ad options, it gives a 1002 error and says the ad failed to produce. I hit the button at least ten times and still get an error so I am unable to proceed with that game aspect until I hit an ad that works.

Now, other than that, this game has a lot of facets to it so I don’t get bored, so I was enjoying this game before that happened. If this bug could be fixed, I would attempt another round.
